chart: China iPhone App Store top-grossing, all apps, top 50 (top 30 from 2025)
day_basis: UTC date of the chart hour Appfigures stamped on the list
note: Past days only -- not updated daily. Each day is one Wayback Machine copy of Appfigures' free chart page, which showed Apple's all-apps top-grossing chart with Apple's own app ids (the same ids as cn_ios.json). t = the chart hour Appfigures stamped on the list, capture = the archive's timestamp (the Wayback Machine, or Common Crawl where via=commoncrawl), depth = rows the page showed. Coverage is only the days someone saved the page -- 2 in 2020, 22-28 a year in 2021-22, 43-83 a year in 2023-25 -- and a tracked game missing from a day ranked below that day's depth. Kept apart from cn_ios.json: someone else's copy, at another hour and depth.
